rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for bringing separate ideas, parts, or pieces together into a coherent whole.

example.english: We need a synthesis of the different departments’ opinions before deciding on the final plan.
example.traditional: 我哋要整合各部門嘅意見，先至定到最後方案。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing2 hap6 gok3 bou6 mun4 ge3 ji3 gin3 sin1 zi3 ding6 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this for technical synthesis, especially forming a chemical compound or generating a waveform from simpler ones.

example.english: This sound is created by synthesis from several simple waveforms.
example.traditional: 個音色係由幾個簡單波形合成出嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: go3 jam1 sik1 hai6 jau4 gei2 go3 gaan2 daan1 bo1 jing4 hap6 sing4 ceot1 lai4 ge3
